text: I think some people are busy with their own life, so they don't think about nature. Also, they believe one person can't change anything. For example, many people throw rubbish in the street because it is easy. I think schools should teach children about this, so they will care more when they grow up. Maybe then things will be better in the future.

tips.en: A concrete example makes the answer convincing and shows the idea is grounded.
tips.kk: Нақты мысал жауапты сенімді етіп, ойдың негізді екенін көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Конкретный пример делает ответ убедительным и показывает, что мысль не пустая.
tips.example: For example, many people throw rubbish in the street because it is easy

tips.en: Cause and result make the reasoning logical.
tips.kk: Себеп пен салдар пайымдауды логикалы етеді.
tips.ru: Причина и следствие делают рассуждение логичным.
tips.example: so they don't think about nature

note.en: to pay more attention to something

questions.followUp: Do you think young people care more?
questions.question: Why do you think some people don't care about the environment?

text: I think the government can make rules for factories. If a factory makes a lot of smoke, it should pay money. Also, they can build more buses and metro, so people use cars less. In my city, the air is bad in winter because of cars. So I believe public transport is the best way to start. That would help a lot.

tips.en: A complex structure (conditional, passive, subordinate clause) raises Grammatical Range.
tips.kk: Күрделі құрылым (шартты, ырықсыз етіс, бағыныңқы) Grammatical Range-ді арттырады.
tips.ru: Сложное предложение (условное, пассив, придаточное) повышает Grammatical Range.
tips.example: If a factory makes a lot of smoke, it should pay money

tips.en: An example from your own city makes the answer personal and convincing.
tips.kk: Өз қаласынан алынған мысал жауапты жеке әрі сенімді етеді.
tips.ru: Пример из своего города делает ответ личным и убедительным.
tips.example: In my city, the air is bad in winter because of cars

note.en: buses, metro and trains used by everyone

questions.question: What can governments do to reduce pollution?

text: Yes, I think it is quite important because it saves things like paper and plastic. In my country, not many people recycle, but it is starting to change. Some shops now have special bins for bottles. I think if the bins are near people's homes, they will use them more. It is a small thing, but it helps. Little by little, it can make a difference.

tips.en: A direct answer plus a reason with because is a clear, simple structure.
tips.kk: Тікелей жауап пен because арқылы себеп — қарапайым әрі анық құрылым.
tips.ru: Прямой ответ плюс причина через because — простая и чёткая структура.
tips.example: because it saves things like paper and plastic

tips.en: Contrast shows two sides of the issue, which works well in Part 3.
tips.kk: Қарама-қайшылық сұрақтың екі жағын көрсетеді — Part 3 үшін күшті тәсіл.
tips.ru: Противопоставление показывает две стороны вопроса — это сильный ход для Part 3.
tips.example: not many people recycle, but it is starting to change

note.en: a softened way to say important

questions.followUp: Do people in your country recycle?
questions.question: Do you think recycling is important?

text: I'm not sure, but I think it will get worse if we don't change our habits. The weather is already becoming hotter, and some animals are disappearing. On the other hand, new technology like solar panels can help. I hope people will understand the problem soon, because we only have one planet. That is why everyone must do something. Even small actions matter.

tips.en: Hedging sounds natural and shows you are weighing the opinion.
tips.kk: Сақ тұжырым табиғи естіледі және пікірді саралап жатқаныңызды көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Осторожная формулировка звучит естественно и показывает, что вы взвешиваете мнение.
tips.example: I'm not sure, but I think it will get worse

tips.en: Contrast shows two sides of the issue, which works well in Part 3.
tips.kk: Қарама-қайшылық сұрақтың екі жағын көрсетеді — Part 3 үшін күшті тәсіл.
tips.ru: Противопоставление показывает две стороны вопроса — это сильный ход для Part 3.
tips.example: On the other hand, new technology like solar panels can help

note.en: devices that produce electricity from sunlight

questions.question: How will the environment change in the future?
